title: simonlin1212/Vibe-Research
claim: Self-hosted 'personal AI research desk' for A-share/US/HK stocks: daily review, news radar, per-stock data, sector center, holdings and research notes in one dashboard — driven by whichever AI you plug in (BYO-AI, MIT).
why_good: Flips the Vibe-Trading wave to the safer wedge — research, not execution: no broker integration, no trade liability, and 'bring your own AI' fits Chinese retail's distrust of black-box bots. 1,043★/242 forks in 3 weeks with 2 maintainers is organic pull.
value: The free dashboard is a funnel; the money is cleaned Chinese-market data plus a hosted tier for A-share retail (~200M accounts) stuck between free-but-messy apps and Wind/Choice terminals priced for institutions.
risk: Rests on scrappy free data feeds upstream sources can cut off overnight, and 东方财富/同花顺 can bolt an AI layer onto proprietary data in a quarter — a dashboard without owned data is copyable.

zh.claim: 自托管的“个人AI研究桌面”，专注于A股/美股/港股：每日回顾、新闻雷达、个股数据、行业中心、持仓和研究笔记一站式仪表盘——由你选择的AI驱动（自带AI，MIT）。
zh.why_good: 将Vibe-Trading的浪潮转向更安全的方向——研究，而非执行：无需经纪人集成，无交易责任，‘自带AI’符合中国散户对黑箱机器人的不信任。3周内获得1043★/242个分支，2名维护者，展现了自然的吸引力。
zh.value: 免费的仪表盘是一个漏斗；真正的价值在于清洗过的中国市场数据，以及为A股散户提供的托管层（约2亿账户），填补了免费但杂乱的应用与面向机构的Wind/Choice终端之间的空白。
zh.risk: 依赖于不稳定的免费数据源，上游来源可能会在一夜之间切断，而东方财富/同花顺可以在一个季度内为专有数据添加AI层——没有自有数据的仪表盘是可以被复制的。
